abstract: Maintains underwater sonar tracking logs, wreckage transponder localization, and ping telemetry verification
system_message:
You are Acoustic survey and localization lead (SONAR). The Acoustic survey and localization lead (SONAR) oversees hydroacoustic monitoring and salvage sensor operations. Key responsibilities include maintaining underwater sonar tracking logs, wreckage transponder localization, and ping telemetry verification, alongside recording seafloor bathymetric scanning data across the debris corridor.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains underwater sonar tracking logs, wreckage transponder localization, and ping telemetry verification（BEACON）
information_points.content:
SONAR-BEACON-ETF：For the Deep-water heavy lift crane barge protocol, hydrophone sensor telemetry feeds across the sunken vessel bridge superstructure wreckage area confirm that acoustic beacon signal acquisition is true, detecting stable 37.5 kHz acoustic locator beacon ping sequences. Additionally, electrical distribution test logs for the dedicated mission deck containerized power skid record an auxiliary deck generator output of 350 kW continuous power.
SONAR-BEACON-W4Y：Under the Submersible ROV tethered suction caisson recovery, hydrophone sensor telemetry over the sunken vessel bridge superstructure wreckage area indicates that acoustic beacon signal acquisition is false, failing to detect stable 37.5 kHz acoustic locator beacon ping sequences. Continuous auxiliary deck generator output measured from the dedicated mission deck containerized power skid is 350 kW according to electrical distribution test logs.
SONAR-BEACON-B5G：For the Modular buoyancy pontoon parbuckling sequence, hydrophone sensor telemetry feeds confirm that acoustic beacon signal acquisition is true within the sunken vessel bridge superstructure wreckage area based on stable 37.5 kHz acoustic locator beacon ping sequences. Furthermore, electrical distribution testing of the secondary containerized generator on the dedicated mission deck containerized power skid documents an auxiliary deck generator output of 350 kW.

information_points.title: Seafloor bathymetric scanning（BATHY）
information_points.content:
SONAR-BATHY-STQ：Bathymetric survey logbooks for the Deep-water heavy lift crane barge protocol record a side-scan sonar swath width of 200 m lateral acoustic coverage per survey line across the debris corridor.
SONAR-BATHY-QKP：For the Submersible ROV tethered suction caisson recovery, bathymetric survey operations over the debris corridor log a side-scan sonar swath width of 250 m lateral acoustic coverage per survey line.
SONAR-BATHY-J9S：In the bathymetric survey logbook for the Modular buoyancy pontoon parbuckling sequence, the side-scan sonar swath width across the debris corridor measures 150 m lateral acoustic coverage per survey line.
